note: The map failure-semantics.md's Enforcement section claims CI asserts. It did not exist, so the claim was false and every F row added made it falser. This file makes the claim checkable: scripts/lint_ci_coverage.py requires every row id in the document to appear here exactly once, every id here to name a live row, and every entry claiming an injection to name a file that exists and mentions the id. An entry may declare `not-yet-injected`, which is recorded and counted rather than hidden -- a register that could silently declare everything uncovered would be the vacuity this file exists to prevent.

statuses.injected: A fault is injected and a test asserts the row's disposition class.
statuses.referenced: A test names the row and asserts part of its disposition, but no fault is injected. Weaker than `injected` and counted separately.
statuses.not-yet-injected: No test names this row. Declared, not excused.
